name: publicWeb_getRunPhotoPins
description: Where and when each Hash-Flash-approved PUBLIC photo of a run was taken, for the public PackTrack map and Trail TV pins. Photos are no longer written into GPS tracks, so maps read pins from photo rows. Same exposure as the PHO:: coordinates the track payload used to carry; the gallery endpoint still returns no coordinates.

rowsets.name: Pins
rowsets.description: Public photos with a real coordinate, oldest first by TakenAtUtc then CreatedAt.

columns.name: TakenAtUtc
columns.description: When it was taken (UTC); NULL on rows before 2026-09-07 — callers fall back to CreatedAt

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never return photos below Status 3 from this unauthenticated endpoint
